operations.purpose: Create a session with the API. Exchanges the credentials supplied in the security context for a session token that authenticates subsequent calls through the vmware-api-session-id header.
Create a virtual machine from an existing virtual machine. The $Task form accepts the work and returns the identifier of the com.vmware.cis.task that performs it.
Return information about a task, including its Cis.Task.Status value. This is the operation the clone description names for querying the result of the accepted work.

supporting_schemas.name: Vcenter.VM.CloneSpec
derived_facts: required: [name, source]
source is an identifier for the resource type VirtualMachine
placement, disks_to_remove, disks_to_update, power_on and guest_customization_spec are optional
when placement is missing or null the system uses the values from the source virtual machine
when power_on is missing or null the virtual machine is not powered on
when disks_to_remove is missing or null all disks are copied

supporting_schemas.name: Vcenter.VM.ClonePlacementSpec

supporting_schemas.name: Cis.Task.Info

SUCCEEDED and FAILED are the only terminal values
